overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: no subcommittee was formally created at the March 7 meeting, and a member's public Facebook post was not a deliberation with a quorum.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board created a subcommittee of two members to revise draft immigrant and refugee policies, which did not comply with the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: However, we find that Ms. Daly, on her own initiative, offered to assist Mr. Greene in carrying out the task.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside a meeting through a board member's public Facebook post linking to draft policies and inviting comments.
allegations.key_passage: Because Mr. Greene's post was directed to members of the public with Facebook accounts, rather than specifically to the Board, and because no Board member responded to the post, we find no violation.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
